android.desc: Receipt Scanner is a smart expense tracker that helps you scan receipts, organize purchases, and understand your spending in one place. Use the built-in OCR receipt scanner to capture receipt details from a photo, including merchant name, purchase date, line items, prices, total amount, and currency. Instead of entering every purchase manually, simply scan, review the extracted information, and save your expense. Whether you need an everyday expense tracker, a receipt organizer app for personal purchases, or an easier way to keep business receipts organized, Receipt Scanner helps keep your financial records clear and accessible. SMART OCR RECEIPT SCANNER Take a photo of a receipt or choose an existing image from your gallery. The OCR receipt scanner reads the receipt and turns the image into structured expense information. Receipt Scanner combines receipt OCR with AI-assisted extraction to identify: • Merchant name • Purchase date • Individual items • Item prices • Total amount • Currency • Spending category The app can also work as a bill scanner when you need to capture information from bills and other purchase documents. With automatic extraction, you spend less time typing and more time reviewing your expenses. EXPENSE TRACKER Keep daily purchases organized with a simple expense tracker designed around receipts. View recent expenses, monthly spending, category totals, and spending trends from your dashboard. Expenses can be organized across categories such as groceries, restaurants, transportation, fuel, shopping, subscriptions, travel, entertainment, and business purchases. Your expense tracker makes it easy to see where your money goes and review previous purchases whenever you need them. RECEIPT ORGANIZER APP Use Receipt Scanner as a receipt organizer app to keep receipt photos and expense information together. The built-in receipt OCR makes paper receipts searchable and easier to manage without keeping piles of physical receipts. A receipt organizer app can also be useful for returns, warranties, reimbursements, work expenses, and preparing records for tax season. BILL SCANNER & RECEIPT OCR Need to digitize a bill or receipt? The bill scanner captures the document while receipt OCR converts visible text into useful expense information.
